scientific_boundary: This snapshot archives the filed IDEA records and the ideation handoff byte-for-byte as PROPOSALS only. No hypothesis, experiment, evidence, or decision record is created and no status changes; approval is /design-experiment under Coordinator authority. No record claims an attack, speedup, closure, or novelty above unverified; every sota_delta is stated quantitatively by its own record and adopted by nobody. Generator-enumerated closures are the generators' claims, reviewed by nobody, and are not adopted by this archive.
self_neutrality: The receipt cannot embed its own final hash, size, commit SHA, or parent SHA. Those remain null; every other declared path is hashed from its final pre-commit bytes under content_first.
